figures_note: Reported figures are computed by the backend from the XBRL facts the company filed with the SEC; each shows the facts it used and its arithmetic.

status_notes.complete: Every claim has verified evidence from the sources requested, and nothing was withheld.
status_notes.partial: Part of the thesis could not be assessed with verified evidence. The reasons are listed under coverage limits.
status_notes.failed: No source could be read, so there is no brief.

verdict_notes.supported: Verified excerpts support the claim and none challenge it.
verdict_notes.challenged: Verified excerpts challenge the claim and none support it.
verdict_notes.unjudged: Relevant passages were found and quoted, but no engine judged whether they support or challenge the claim.
verdict_notes.not_addressed: No verified excerpt in the passages retrieved bears on the claim.

provenance_note: Evidence comes from the company's own filings with the SEC. It shows what the company reported, not whether an outside party agrees.
review_note: The verdict after your review follows by the same rule from the findings you accepted, and undecided findings do not count toward it.
no_checker_note: No second model checked the findings' meaning.

example.decision: Whether to keep an overweight position in NVIDIA into the next earnings report
claims: Data center revenue is still growing year over year.
A small number of customers account for a large share of revenue.
Export controls on sales to China are restricting revenue.
The company depends on a limited number of suppliers to manufacture its products.
